amala.name: Amala
visualHallmarks: Velvety dark brown yam flour swallow (Amala isu)
Served with Ewedu and Gbegiri soup
amala.culinaryNotes: Traditional Yoruba swallow made from dried yam flour (elubo), whipped in hot water to dark velvet consistency.

jollof-rice.name: Jollof Rice
visualHallmarks: Glossy smoky orange-red long grain rice
jollof-rice.culinaryNotes: Distinct grains coated in reduced tomato-tatashe paste with thyme and bay aromatics.

egusi-soup.name: Egusi Soup
visualHallmarks: Braised assorted meats and ugu greens
egusi-soup.culinaryNotes: Textured melon seed protein cakes simmered in palm oil with stockfish and leafy greens.

suya.name: Suya
visualHallmarks: Thinly sliced skewered beef with char marks
Sliced red onions and fresh tomatoes
suya.culinaryNotes: Open-flame charcoal grilled beef dusted with authentic Northern Nigerian yaji pepper.

efo-riro.name: Efo Riro
efo-riro.culinaryNotes: Yoruba vegetable stew prepared by tossing greens into seasoned fried pepper reduction.

moin-moin.name: Moin Moin
visualHallmarks: Hard-boiled egg or fish slice inclusion
moin-moin.culinaryNotes: Pureed peeled black-eyed peas steamed in banana leaves or ramekins with peppers and crayfish.

chin-chin.name: Chin Chin
chin-chin.culinaryNotes: Deep-fried West African pastry cubes seasoned with grated nutmeg and butter.

pounded-yam.name: Pounded Yam
pounded-yam.culinaryNotes: Steamed African white yam pounded in a mortar until starchy, stretchy, and pillowy.

spaghetti-bolognese.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
spaghetti-bolognese.culinaryNotes: Classic Italian ragù alla bolognese clinging to long pasta with fresh basil accents.

grilled-chicken.name: Grilled Chicken
grilled-chicken.culinaryNotes: Flame-roasted seasoned poultry with caramelized exterior and tender interior.

vegetable-salad.name: Vegetable Salad
visualHallmarks: Sliced English cucumbers and ruby cherry tomatoes
Golden boiled egg wedges and sweetcorn
vegetable-salad.culinaryNotes: Vibrant chilled fresh produce composed on a platter with light vinaigrette.
